description: This file defines a class 'Migration' for handling database schema migrations within the OrangeHRM system, specifically for version 4.3.3. It includes methods for applying schema changes, such as changing column types and managing foreign keys, as part of the migration process.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: A class representing a database migration for version 4.3.3 in OrangeHRM, handling schema updates and foreign key management.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Executes the migration steps including adjusting column types and handling conflicting foreign keys.

methods.name: getConflictingForeignKeys
methods.description: Identifies foreign keys that conflict with the intended schema changes, for removal before applying changes.

methods.name: removeConflictingForeignKeys
methods.description: Drops foreign keys identified as conflicting with the new schema.

methods.name: recreateRemovedForeignKeys
methods.description: Restores previously removed foreign keys after schema modifications are applied.
